input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: Section 26 selects California law and Section 27 gives exclusive merits jurisdiction to the state or federal courts in San Luis Obispo County, California, with no arbitration seat anywhere. That sits squarely at our fallback position (Delaware/California law with the corresponding Delaware or California courts), so no redline is warranted. We note only that our preferred position is New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in New York County, and that the chosen venue is TrueLink's home county (both parties are in any event California-based); these are wording preferences short of preferred, not material failures of the fallback.

mappings.quote: Any and all disputes between the parties that cannot be settled by mutual agreement shall be resolved solely and exclusively in the state or federal courts located within San Luis Obispo County, California, and each party consents to the jurisdiction of such courts
